{
  "analysis": "The current /app/pipeline_parallel.py compiles, but it likely uses shifted labels and always computes rotary position embeddings even when the local layer range does not accept a position_embeddings argument. I will patch it to use unshifted cross_entropy against the provided targets and only compute/pass position_embeddings when at least one local layer accepts that argument. Then I will verify syntax again.",
  "plan": "Run a Python patch script against /app/pipeline_parallel.py to add _needs_position_embeddings, gate rotary position embedding computation, and replace the shifted loss with non-shifted loss. Then print the changed sections and run py_compile.",
  "commands": [
    {
      "keystrokes": "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('/app/pipeline_parallel.py')
s = p.read_text()

needle = "def _compute_position_embeddings(rotary_emb, hidden, position_ids, cache_position):\n"
helper = '''def _needs_position_embeddings(layers, start, end):
    for i in range(start, end):
        try:
            if "position_embeddings" in inspect.signature(layers[i].forward).parameters:
                return True
        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            pass
    return False


'''
if "_needs_position_embeddings" not in s:
    s = s.replace(needle, helper + needle)

old = '''        rotary_emb = _get_rotary_emb(base, layers)
        position_embeddings = _compute_position_embeddings(rotary_emb, hidden, position_ids, cache_position)

        hidden = _run_layer_range(
'''
new = '''        if _needs_position_embeddings(layers, start, end):
            rotary_emb = _get_rotary_emb(base, layers)
            position_embeddings = _compute_position_embeddings(rotary_emb, hidden, position_ids, cache_position)
        else:
            position_embeddings = None

        hidden = _run_layer_range(
'''
if old not in s:
    raise SystemExit('position_embeddings block not found')
s = s.replace(old, new)

old_loss = '''def _compute_loss(norm, lm_head, hidden, target, num_microbatches):
    features = hidden
    if norm is not None:
        features = norm(features)
    logits = lm_head(features)

    # Standard causal LM shift: position t predicts t+1.
    shift_logits = logits[..., :-1, :].contiguous()
    shift_target = target[..., 1:].contiguous()
    loss = F.cross_entropy(
        shift_logits.view(-1, shift_logits.size(-1)),
        shift_target.view(-1).to(shift_logits.device),
        ignore_index=-100,
        reduction="mean",
    )
    return loss / num_microbatches
'''
new_loss = '''def _compute_loss(norm, lm_head, hidden, target, num_microbatches):
    features = hidden
    if norm is not None:
        features = norm(features)
    logits = lm_head(features)

    loss = F.cross_entropy(
        logits.reshape(-1, logits.size(-1)),
        target.reshape(-1).to(logits.device),
        ignore_index=-100,
        reduction="mean",
    )
    return loss / num_microbatches
'''
if old_loss not in s:
    raise SystemExit('old loss block not found')
s = s.replace(old_loss, new_loss)

p.write_text(s)
print('patched')
PY

",
      "duration": 0.1
    },
    {
